scenes.title: Why it was built
scenes.narration: It was built for the U.S. Army, to work out where artillery shells would land, for the firing tables gun crews used. It was unveiled on February fifteenth, nineteen forty-six.
scenes.visual: P4 firing-table page, slow pan down a column (0:20-0:26); P2 changing a tube, static (0:26-0:31).

scenes.title: The most ENIAC thing
scenes.narration: So aiming a gun is the most ENIAC thing you can do. Our kiosk lets you, on a simulation that follows the real machine pulse by pulse.

scenes.title: Pick a ship
scenes.narration: Here's the game. An enemy destroyer, just under eleven thousand feet away. I pick a destroyer, its quick gun, and the steepest angle: twenty degrees.

scenes.title: Two numbers
scenes.narration: Ships and guns are just the game. My gun and angle become two numbers on the Constant Transmitter. The simulated machine does the rest.

scenes.title: The room walk
scenes.narration: The kiosk places every cable and switch for me. The Master Programmer is the conductor. The accumulators hold the numbers: which hop, how far along, how high.

scenes.title: Flight A
scenes.narration: This is firing-table arithmetic: fifty tiny steps for every second of flight. The multiplier squares the speed. Function Table Two looks up how hard the air pushes back. The punch makes one card: one dot. Join the dots, and that's the shell's path.
scenes.visual: Flight A condensed by jump cuts on the full 1920x1080 plot (recording runs about 3.7 s/hop; 16 hops is about a minute). No crops or punch-ins. Last 2 hops uncut; VO10 ends before the second-to-last card; one drum on the second-to-last card, NO drum on the last card, so the final hop (about 3.7 s) falls in silence into the splash.

scenes.title: Splash: 515 short
scenes.narration: Short. Five hundred and fifteen feet short. That's the destroyer's fastest gun at the steepest angle. It can't reach.
scenes.visual: Landing pulse just short of the enemy; hold the splash about 1.2 s, jump-cut over the kiosk's wait to the result: '515 ft short' (expected), points 934 and rank 'Sharpshooter' (expected).

scenes.music: SFX water splash (no explosion) on the landing pulse; M4 trombone 'missed' figure on the result reveal; VO11 about 1.0 s after the result appears

scenes.title: More speed
scenes.narration: In this game, the same shot always lands in the same place. So I need more speed: a bigger ship. The cruiser. Its long gun. With that speed, I aim lower: ten degrees.

VO12 over Fire again + aim screen; VO13 in three phrases on the three taps ('ten degrees' on the 10° tap).
